title: Product Photography for Miami Brands
metaTitle: Product Photography for Miami Brands | TDM
metaDescription: Product shoots for Miami e-commerce brands: catalog, lifestyle and detail images, retouched and sized for your store, Amazon and ads. Ship products, approve remotely.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) photographs products for Miami brands that sell through their own store, on marketplaces such as Amazon, or through paid social. The work covers art direction, shooting, retouching and delivery in every crop each channel needs. We do not have a photo studio in Miami: you ship your products to our production hub in Lahore, approve the shot list and art direction remotely, and receive finished images digitally.

sections.heading: What Miami sells, and why the photos carry the sale
paragraphs: A great deal of what Miami brands make is bought on appearance. Swimwear and resort wear, much of it tied to the designers who show during Swim Week. Beauty, skincare and fragrance. Jewellery and accessories. Rum, coffee, sauces and other food products rooted in the city's Cuban, Caribbean and Latin American kitchens. Furniture and decor from the showrooms around the Design District. A customer in Chicago or Madrid cannot pick any of it up. The image has to stand in for holding the product.
Many of these businesses also wholesale. Buyers for boutiques, hotels and distributors in Latin America expect a clean, consistent catalog, and a line sheet with mismatched phone photos costs orders.

sections.heading: How a remote product shoot works from Miami
paragraphs: We map your catalog and channels and define a set list: catalog angles, lifestyle scenes and detail shots per product. You send one sample of each item, not your inventory. We confirm condition on arrival, shoot against the approved list with lighting and styling kept consistent, retouch the selects and send them for review. After your notes are applied, finals are exported in every crop and resolution and delivered named and organised.

This is an international shipment, so it needs a little planning. Allow transit time in your launch schedule, declare samples properly for customs, and check with us first about anything fragile, perishable, liquid or restricted, since alcohol and some fragrances cannot be sent by ordinary courier. Where a product cannot travel, we will say so instead of promising a shoot we cannot do well.
bullets: Studio catalog images on white or coloured backgrounds, consistent across the whole range.
Styled lifestyle scenes with props and surfaces that suit a warm-weather, coastal brand without relying on a real beach.
Macro detail shots of fabric, stitching, labels, finishes and mechanisms.
Sets that meet Amazon and other marketplace requirements for background, framing and resolution.
Colour-accurate retouching, because misleading images come back as returns.
Files sized for your store, marketplace listings, ads and social templates.

sections.heading: When a local photographer is the better choice
paragraphs: Some shoots have to happen in Miami. Swimwear on models at the beach, a restaurant's dishes as they leave the kitchen, furniture too large to ship, or anything needed within days all call for a photographer on the spot. Our service fits products that travel well and catalogs where consistency matters more than location. In the consultation we will tell you which case you are in. Often the answer is both: shipped products for the catalog, and a local session for the campaign images.

sections.heading: What to check before commissioning a shoot
paragraphs: Agree the number of images per product and the angles before anything is photographed. Confirm that retouching and all export sizes are included. Ask how colour accuracy is checked, especially for fabrics and cosmetics. And ask what happens to your samples afterwards: returned, kept for a later shoot, or disposed of.

presence: A member of our team is based in Miami and can help you plan the shot list and the shipment. The photography and retouching are done at our production hub in Lahore, with approvals handled online.

faqs.q: Do you have a product photography studio in Miami?
faqs.a: No. A member of our team is based in Miami, but products are photographed at TDM's studio in Lahore. You ship samples, approve the shot list remotely and receive retouched images digitally.

faqs.q: How do I send my products for the shoot?
faqs.a: You send one sample of each item by international courier, declared as samples. We confirm the address, packing advice and any restrictions for your product type before you ship, and check condition when the parcel arrives.

faqs.q: How much does product photography cost?
faqs.a: It depends on the number of products, the images per product and how much styling the lifestyle scenes need. We quote after a free consultation and a look at your catalog.

faqs.q: Will the images meet Amazon requirements?
faqs.a: Yes, when that is part of the brief. We shoot and export main and secondary images to marketplace specifications for background, framing and resolution, alongside the versions for your own store and ads.

faqs.q: How long does a product shoot take from Miami?
faqs.a: It depends on the size of the catalog, the brief and shipping time. The schedule, including transit, is agreed in the plan, so tell us about any launch date at the start.
